episodeTitle.en: Why every company now needs to think and operate like a lab team | Josh Woodward (VP Google Labs)
episodeTitle.zh: 为什么每家公司现在都需要像实验室团队那样思考和运作？｜Google Labs 副总裁 Josh Woodward

guestBioOfficial.zh: Josh Woodward 负责 Google Labs、Gemini 应用和 AI Studio，在 Google 工作了十多年。他带的团队既孵化新想法，也负责把其中一些做成大规模产品，日常难题是何时给实验更多时间。
guestBioOfficial.en: Josh leads Google Labs, the Gemini app, and AI Studio. A longtime Google product leader, he oversees both early experiments and products that have to reach a large audience.

title.en: Why every company now needs to think and operate like a lab team | Josh Woodward (VP Google Labs)
title.zh: 为什么每家公司现在都需要像实验室团队那样思考和运作？｜Google Labs 副总裁 Josh Woodward

summary.zh: 在 Google Labs，探索可以从「未来人们会怎样娱乐」开始，却得在有期限的实验里落地。Josh 讲了模型迭代怎样影响计划、为什么不急于合并相似的尝试，以及实验室如何在探索和投入之间切换。
summary.en: Josh describes moving from a question about the future of entertainment to a time-bounded experiment. Model releases shape the planning rhythm; overlapping bets force decisions about when to coordinate and when to let teams explore.

insights.title: 问题可以从行为变化开始
insights.detail: Labs 会同时问技术能做到什么、人们三年后可能怎样娱乐。把两条线索放在一起，有助于确定值得试验的方向。
insights.detailEn: Labs pairs emerging capabilities with hypotheses about how people might behave, such as how entertainment could change over three years.
insights.titleEn: Start with a change in behavior

insights.title: 把远期方向落到百日进展
insights.detail: 团队大致按半年规划，以覆盖模型更新的节奏，同时追问约一百天后产品应有什么可见的推进。
insights.detailEn: A roughly six-month window accommodates model releases; a nearer hundred-day horizon forces the team to define tangible progress.
insights.titleEn: Give the experiment a nearer horizon

insights.title: 暂时重叠的实验未必需要马上合并
insights.detail: 多个小组探索互动娱乐，看似在争同一池鱼。Josh 会先观察哪些方向自然浮现，再决定何处值得协作。
insights.detailEn: Overlapping experiments can look inefficient. Josh sometimes tolerates the mess before deciding which work benefits from coordination.

related.reason: 比较大团队的实验节奏与产品团队日常的持续用户发现。
related.reasonEn: Compare lab experiments with continuous discovery in a product team.

title.en: Build better products with continuous product discovery | Teresa Torres
title.zh: 通过持续产品探索打造更优质产品 | 特蕾莎·托雷斯
